notes: TIER 1 ONLY (direct HTTP fetch via curl, no Playwright/Chrome needed): homepage returned full SSR HTML (~2MB) with an embedded site-wide category-tree JSON (901 unique /jp/ja/cat/ links) plus per-page 'hierarchyObjs' JSON and schema.org JSON-LD (ItemList/CollectionPage/BreadcrumbList) on every category page, matching the pattern already seen on IKEA UAE. robots.txt (global, ikea.com) has no Claude-specific disallow; only generic disallows for search/filter/sort query strings, which is why internal-search fetches were skipped in favor of nav-tree + JSON-LD evidence. Qty method: primary source was the '<N>件中<M>件表示' (showing M of N) text on each PLP, which frequently exceeds the JSON-LD numberOfItems (that field caps at the first page, e.g. 24) - used the larger true total in that case; cross-checked against raw '@type':'Product' counts in the JSON-LD ItemList. CHRISTMAS/WINTER: the site's own URL slug for the hub is 'christmas-shop-wt001' though its on-page Japanese label is 'ウィンターコレクション' (Winter Collection); many of its children display 'クリスマスにおすすめ' (Recommended for Christmas) in their titles, so all wt001-descended nodes were classified under category=Christmas. wt001 itself and 'christmas-decorations-49149' (title '冬のデコレーション') and 'christmas-food-49227' (title '食料品（ウィンターコレクション）') each aggregate their own children's products (own total <= union of children, i.e. children are subsets) so those three were kept as is_group grouping rows per the parent/child rule, and only their leaf children were counted as rows to avoid double-counting. Two additional, separately-numbered named product-line collections outside the wt001 tree were found via the 'Collections' hub (collection-collections) and are explicitly Christmas-branded by their own page titles: VINTERFINT ('クリスマスにおすすめの通販') and 'Holiday IKEA x Gustaf Westman/クリスマスコレクション' (title literally says Christmas Collection) - both included as separate rows since they are distinct site taxonomy nodes with their own URLs/counts, not literal duplicates of the wt001 branch. EXCLUDED: 'christmas-pots-vases-49160' (title 'クリスマスにおすすめの鉢カバー・花瓶') is a child of 49151 in the breadcrumb and, on inspection, lists the exact same single product (PÅDRAG vase, id 50470989) as its parent 49151 - a literal duplicate listing, so it was dropped and only 49151 kept (this note satisfies the dup-recording requirement). 'wrapping-paper-gift-bags-accessories-25227' was found nested inside the wt001 hierarchy JSON blob but its own breadcrumb/parent field resolves to the general 'インテリア雑貨' (Decoration, de001) node, not wt001 - its title merely says 'recommended for Christmas' on a category that is fundamentally a general stationery/gift-wrap category (site's own taxonomy does not file it under the holiday hub), so it was excluded per the 'category that merely contains seasonal products is not itself seasonal' rule. Two generic 'season' campaign links found on the homepage ('季節のおすすめ', '季節の衣替え特集' - seasonal recommendations / seasonal wardrobe-change storage) are marketing/landing campaign pages, not holiday-specific PLPs, and were excluded. HALLOWEEN: found via homepage editorial banner explicitly captioned 'ハロウィンを演出するコレクション' (a collection that creates Halloween atmosphere) for the KUSTFYR/クストフィール product line; its own dedicated category page (kustfyr-collection-700668, under the generic 'Collections' hub) is a genuine PLP with 24 products (numberOfItems:24, 24 Product entries, no subcategories) - all pumpkin/spider/ghost themed per product titles. No separate Halloween taxonomy branch exists outside this single collection. ABSENCE CHECKS: searched the full 901-line site category-tree dump plus targeted greps (case-insensitive) for christmas/xmas/halloween/easter/valentine/diwali/thanksgiving/new-year/newyear/oshogatsu/shogatsu/nenga/festival/matsuri/spring/summer/autumn/winter and the Japanese terms クリスマス/ハロウィン/お正月/正月/イースター/バレンタイン/季節/雛/七夕/節分 - found only the Christmas/Winter and Halloween nodes documented above (plus one irrelevant 'spring-mattresses' hit, a bed-spring product, not a season). No New Year (お正月/Oshogatsu), Easter, Valentine's Day, Diwali, or Thanksgiving category page or hub node exists anywhere in the embedded nav tree, the Collections hub (28 named product-line collections enumerated, only 3 holiday-themed), or the wt001 sub-tree. Internal site search was not used as evidence per the task's 'zero-result search is not proof of absence' rule and because robots.txt disallows crawling search-result query URLs; absence is instead based on the comprehensive site-wide category-tree JSON and Collections-hub enumeration described above.
